name: Gemini Chat Agent Starter Kit
tagline: A modular starter kit for building custom Gemini agents with multi-modal reasoning, audited tool execution, encrypted session persistence, and Looker extension compatibility.

starterPrompts.title: Data Profiling
starterPrompts.description: Profile JSON datasets, columns, null rates, and summary statistics.
starterPrompts.prompt: Can you inspect this sample JSON data: [{"order_id": 101, "revenue": 240.5, "status": "completed"}, {"order_id": 102, "revenue": 180.0, "status": "pending"}]

starterPrompts.title: Skills & Tools
starterPrompts.description: Discover registered skills and functions available to the agent.
starterPrompts.prompt: What skills and tools do you currently have registered?

starterPrompts.title: Safe Calculations
starterPrompts.description: Execute verified math expressions via the calculator skill.
starterPrompts.prompt: Calculate the compound annual growth rate if initial is 120000 and final is 340000 over 5 years.

starterPrompts.title: Looker Integration
starterPrompts.description: Learn how to connect this agent to Looker extensions and iframe URLs.
starterPrompts.prompt: How can I embed this agent interface inside a Looker dashboard or extension?

starterPrompts.title: Prompt Architect
starterPrompts.description: Architect a production system prompt, guardrails, and manifest for your agent.
starterPrompts.prompt: Help me architect a production system prompt and configuration for my custom agent. What questions do you need answered to build the blueprint?

starterPrompts.title: Prompt Audit
starterPrompts.description: Evaluate and upgrade an existing agent prompt against Gemini best practices.
starterPrompts.prompt: Can you audit and improve an existing system prompt for me? Here is my current draft: 'You are a helpful domain assistant. Answer questions accurately and be nice.'
